latestVersion.changelog:
- Now requires Aliyun CLI version 3.3.3 or higher (previously 3.3.1).  
- Added explicit steps to run `aliyun plugin update` to keep CLI plugins up-to-date.
- The `--user-agent` parameter must now include the skill name for all CLI commands.
